Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 103. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

Your martial training has helped you develop a
particular style of fighting. As a result, you learn one
Fighting Style option of your choice from the Martial
Artist class. If you already have a style, the one you
choose must be different.
Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability
Score Improvement feature, you can replace this feat’s
fighting style with another one from the fighter class
that you don’t have.
